Title:                           AI Analyst (AI Infrastructure management)

Client  :                       Hospitality Domain 

What our client is looking for:

Job Duties:

·        Support the AI infrastructure to enable stakeholders to identify business processes that can be enhanced or automated using AI/ML.

·        Support the AI infrastructure to enable stakeholders to conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of AI solutions (predictive analytics, computer vision, NLP) against business constraints.

·        Work closely with stakeholders to ensure data pipelines lifecycle.

·        Perform root cause analysis on AI infrastructure for any model failures or unexpected outputs.

·        Enable prompt-engineer Large Language Models (GPT, Claude, local Qwen)

·        Enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, ensuring data context is accurate and hallucination rates are low.

·        Perform AI infrastructure benchmarking

·        Act as resources for AI related operation, project implementation, local LLM deployment, capacity planning and troubleshooting.

·        Handle AI related frameworks and python packages upgrade.

·        Deal with configuration and troubleshooting for Nvidia hardware and relevant drivers including CUDA.

·        Integrate AI hardware and inference framework plus application (must)

 

 

Requirements:

Experience

·        Proficiency with Linux environment and python

·        Languages: proficiency in Python (Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn), R.

·        SQL: Advanced ability to write complex queries and work with relational databases (Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL).

·        BI Tools: Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI).

·        MLOps: Familiarity with model tracking tools (MLflow & Biases) and cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI).

·        LLM Stack: Experience with LangChain or vector databases PGVector is desirable.

·        Data science experience such as airflow implementation and relevant data pipeline configuration.

·        Experience with MLOps pipelines and CI/CD for machine learning.

·        Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.

·        Implementation and maintenance of local AI inference making use of open source models like Qwen3.5

 

Education

·        Bachelor’s degree in information technology or equivalent relevant qualifications

·        Preferred with AI related certificates

Skills / Competencies

·        Ability to communicate effectively in English and Cantonese/Mandarin

·        Good listening skills & customer service expertise

·        Ability to work as part of a team to accomplish common goals

·        Log, troubleshoot, and track problems to a successful conclusion

Ability to present ideas in user-friendly language to non-technical personnel and end users

Design, develop, and maintain BI and analytics solutions, including enterprise reports, dashboards, and data services

Diploma or Degree holder in Computer Science, Information Technology or related discipline.

Experience with SSRS and/or Power BI is highly preferred

Experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS) is an advantage, especially services related to data engineering (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks)

Programming experience in one or more languages such as Python, C#, or JavaScript is an advantage.

Interest or exposure in web development (e.g., building internal web apps, APIs, or analytics portals) is a plus

Interest in AI-powered analytics (e.g., natural language querying, LLM-assisted reporting) is a plus

title: Robotics Navigation & Embodied AI Engineer
jd_raw:
关于我们

AIdea Technologies Limited 2024 年于香港成立，由香港中文大学顶尖教授与资深科研团队创立，依托近 20 年多模态感知与边缘智能技术深耕，是一家专注多模态感知 × Edge AI × 具身智能的前沿科技企业。

我们以隐私优先、场景落地为核心，将多模态 AI、LLM/VLM 大模型深度融入家庭、康养与商业空间，打造无感、安全、智能的下一代健康守护体验。公司核心产品包括隐私保护热成像监测、家庭健康助手、早期临床诊断系统等，精准解决行业隐私焦虑、佩戴率低、预警滞后等核心痛点，覆盖康养机构、社区与家庭全场景。

面向未来，我们正式迈入家庭康养机器人新纪元—— 在原有无感监测能力之上，打造可自主导航、精准感知、自然交互、主动关怀的家用康养守护机器人，让 AI 从 “被动监测” 走向 “主动陪伴”，构建从安全预警、健康管理到主动服务的全链路智能康养生态。

我们希望找到一位既能扎实落地底层导航与 SLAM，又对具身智能（VLN / Agentic Robot）有热情的工程师，和我们一起把机器人从原型推进到真实产品。

你将参与

底盘自主与运动控制：负责移动机器人底盘的自主导航、路径规划、避障与运动控制。

定位与建图（SLAM）：基于激光 / 视觉 SLAM 实现环境建图、实时定位与重定位，处理动态环境下的鲁棒性问题。

人体感知与跟随：开发行人跟踪、人体姿态识别与人物跟随能力，支撑机器人在有人环境中的安全交互。

具身智能与 Agent 系统：参与视觉语言导航（VLN）与 Agentic Robot 系统开发，重点建设 Agent 的 空间记忆 能力，让机器人能够理解、记忆并复用环境与任务信息。

系统集成与工程验证：在 ROS / ROS2 框架下完成各模块集成、调试与测试评估，快速验证技术方案并参与产品迭代。

关于你

基础要求：

硕士学位（计算机 / 电子 / 自动化 / 机器人 / AI 相关方向），或本科 + 1–2 年相关全职经验。

具备移动机器人 底盘自主导航与运动控制 的项目经验（路径规划、避障、控制等）。

熟悉 激光 / 视觉 SLAM，有建图与定位相关的工程实践。

有 行人跟踪 / 人体姿态识别 相关的开发或落地经验。

对 VLN、Agentic Robot 系统 有了解或实践，尤其是 Agent 空间记忆 方向的开发经验（强加分，优秀者可优先考虑）。

熟悉 ROS / ROS2 下的开发流程与常用工具链。

熟练 C / C++ 与 Python，熟悉 Linux 开发环境；有 PyTorch 或相关深度学习框架使用经验。

动手能力强：能独立推进方案验证、问题定位和工程实现。

能够阅读英文技术文档，进行基本的中英文沟通。

加分项：

熟悉常见导航 / SLAM 框架与工具（如 Nav2、move_base、Cartographer、ORB-SLAM、LIO/LVIO、gmapping 等）。

有 LiDAR / 深度相机 / IMU / ToF 等传感器的标定与多传感器融合经验。

有真机调试与硬件联调经验，熟悉机器人底盘、电机驱动、嵌入式控制等。

有 机械臂相关项目 的开发经验（如运动学 / 抓取规划、MoveIt、力控、视觉伺服等）。

有 VLM / LLM 在机器人任务规划、指令理解或 Agent 工作流中的落地经验。

有模型部署 / 端侧推理经验（如推理服务、量化 / 蒸馏、INT8/INT4 等）。

有 Gazebo / Isaac Sim / MuJoCo 等仿真平台使用经验。

在医疗 / 养老 / 服务机器人 / IoT 赛道有实际产品落地经验。

有开源项目、机器人比赛、硬件 hackathon 等可展示作品。

能用 Cursor / Claude Code / Codex 等 AI 编程工具显著放大自己的工程产出。

你将获得

有竞争力的薪酬，长期香港工作签证，并视贡献提供长期激励。

完整的项目参与度：从硬件选型、算法设计到产品优化全流程参与，直接参与真实机器人产品的持续迭代。

资深团队：与多模态感知、AI、机器人与硬件工程方向的资深技术专家与工程团队共事。

本岗位主要招聘全职。

As a Large Model Algorithm Engineer, you will focus on the technical research and development of Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal large models, driving their application in industrial vertical domains. You will participate in core processes such as model training, optimization, and inference deployment while collaborating with top university research teams to explore cutting-edge technologies and improve model performance and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for training, fine-tuning (SFT), and system deployment of vertical domain large models, promoting efficient application of large models in industrial environments.

Research and implement compression and optimization techniques for large models, including pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, to improve inference efficiency and deployment performance.

Participate in the algorithm design and development of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Agent modules to enhance reasoning capabilities in dynamic and complex environments.

Research and apply multimodal understanding technologies to optimize the application of Large Vision Models (LVM) in industrial vision and other fields.

Translate business rules into efficient workflow code and participate in the design and implementation of Agentic Workflow to enhance workflow intelligence.

Build industry datasets to support large model training and applications, including data preprocessing, pretraining data construction, and training/application/evaluation dataset setup.

Research and implement large model merging techniques, exploring collaborative optimization solutions for multiple models.

Develop and maintain validation, evaluation, and performance monitoring processes for large models to ensure system stability and usability.

Participate in the development and optimization of large model application platforms (microservices) to enhance system modularity and usability.

Qualifications

Master’s degree or higher in Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.

Proficient in machine learning, deep learning, and Transformer architecture, with hands-on experience in end-to-end training and development of large models.

Familiar with large model compression and optimization methods such as pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation.

Strong capabilities in large-scale data processing and familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark), with experience in data preprocessing, cleaning, and building training datasets.

Skilled in Python, C/C++, and Linux programming, with a solid foundation in algorithms and data structures.

Familiar with mainstream large model training and inference frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face (HF), DeepSpeed, PEFT, vLLM, TRL, etc.

Knowledge of Triton or other high-performance inference tools, with experience in applying model optimization to real-world deployments.

Proficient in Docker and Linux shell scripting; experience with FastAPI development is a plus.

Experience in enterprise-level large model development, optimization, deployment, and tool development is preferred.

Strong teamwork and communication skills, capable of collaborating with cross-domain teams.

Passionate about cutting-edge large model technologies and their applications in industrial vertical domains.

Bonus Points

Experience in RAG systems and Agent module development and optimization.

Familiarity with CUDA programming, distributed computing, or related high-performance computing technologies.

Publications in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR).

Knowledge of hardware acceleration technologies (e.g., GPU, TPU) and their applications in model optimization.

We are seeking a hands-on technical leader to drive our AI strategy and build enterprise-grade AI capabilities from the ground up. You will architect and deliver scalable AI platforms, lead a talented team, and translate business needs into production AI solutions that create measurable value.

This is a leadership position for a technical expert who combines deep AI expertise with a strong delivery focus and the ability to operate effectively in a regulated environment.

 

Key Responsibilities:

1. AI Platform Architecture & Development

Lead the design, development, and scaling of robust AI/ML platforms and infrastructure (on-premise and hybrid)

Drive MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps practices to accelerate model development, deployment, and lifecycle management

To build and optimize production AI solutions, including RAG pipelines and multi-agent systems

Deploy, optimize, and scale Large Language Model (LLM) and agent workflows with a focus on performance, cost, reliability, and observability

Fine-tune models, design robust evaluation and monitoring systems, and implement multi-agent architectures with appropriate guardrails

Strengthen knowledge-based AI capabilities through advanced RAG pipelines and vector database solutions

Evaluate emerging technologies, lead proof-of-concept initiatives, and implement Infrastructure-as-Code (Kubernetes, etc.)

 

2. Team Leadership & Business Alignment

Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing AI solution team

Develop and manage a structured AI transformation roadmap, incorporating defined milestones, investment thresholds, and decision gates

Implement a structured AI use-case intake and prioritization framework

Drive initiatives to enhance overall AI maturity and capability across functions

Serve as the key bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating requirements into deliverable AI initiatives

Actively contribute hands-on through architecture reviews, solution design, and critical implementation work

Ensure high availability, performance, and cost-efficiency of AI infrastructure

Maintain secure, compliant, and repeatable deployment processes in line with regulatory standards

Manage operational excellence, incident response, and continuous improvement of AI platforms

Define KPIs, success metrics, and governance frameworks for AI initiatives in partnership with key stakeholders

Establish mechanisms to monitor performance, track ROI, and manage risk across the AI portfolio

 

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

Strong recent hands-on expertise in LLMs, generative AI, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems

Legend Interiors Limited is the leading interior fit-out specialist in Asia.  Found and headquartered in Hong Kong since 1988, our clientele includes some of the world’s most renowned brands in retail, hospitality, residential and commercial space. With global offices in Hong Kong, Macau, Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Dongguan (Factory), Sydney, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok and Ho Chi Minh City, we are looking for high calibre candidates to join our HK team located in Kowloon Bay.

The AI Engineer focuses on designing, building, deploying, and maintaining scalable AI-enabled applications and enterprise systems that solve business problems, improve operations, and support digital transformation.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into scalable, secure, and high-impact AI solutions.

• Design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI/LLM-powered applications, machine learning models, and enterprise systems from prototype through production.

• Build and integrate backend services, APIs, and data pipelines to support AI-enabled applications and enterprise platforms.

• Develop AI agents and intelligent workflows using techniques such as RAG, structured data querying, and tool or function calling.

• Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems, cloud environments, web applications, and mobile applications where needed.

• Monitor, optimize, and continuously improve system performance, reliability, observability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

• Ensure proper governance, security, access control, logging, documentation, and compliance throughout the AI solution lifecycle.

• Lead or support system architecture, testing, deployment, release management, and production support activities.

• Conduct experiments, proofs of concept, benchmarking, and technical evaluations of emerging AI models, tools, and frameworks.

title: AI Software Engineer - Strategic Office - Toptier MNC
jd_raw:
Key Responsibilities

As the AI Solutions Engineer, Office of the Group CEO, you will be the primary technical partner responsible for building practical AI tools and workflows that reduce information latency and support faster strategic decisions.

This is a builder role focused on turning high-level goals into working tools, prototypes and production-ready services using LLMs, agentic AI, data engineering and strong software discipline. It is not an architecture-only or research role; success is measured by reliable solutions that work day-to-day. Your day will typically include:

1. Agentic AI & Intelligent Data Extraction

Build Autonomous Agents: Design and deploy AI agents and automated data pipelines to extract, structure, and synthesize complex insights across internal corporate systems and external platforms.

Deliver Executive Insights: Construct low-latency dashboards, unified visual interfaces, and reporting tools that aggregate cross-functional data to directly support the CEO's decision-making.

2. Production-Grade Engineering & Infrastructure

Scale Backend Services: Architect and maintain robust backend infrastructure, platform components, and data pipelines optimized for high-volume AI workloads.

Apply Practical ML: Implement data analytics, forecasting models, and light machine learning where they materially elevate enterprise decision quality.

Enforce Best Practices: Drive rigorous software engineering standards, including CI/CD, automated testing, version control, infrastructure automation, and clear technical documentation.

Ensure Alignment: Guarantee all data and AI solutions fully comply with group technology standards, security frameworks, and architectural guardrails.

3. Rapid Prototyping & Pipeline Management (MLOps/LLMOps)

CEO Innovation Lab: Rapidly build and test bespoke prototype tools for the CEO, successfully maturing high-performing experiments into production-grade enterprise services.

Manage LLM Lifecycles: Operate MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for model packaging, version control, deployment, live monitoring, and rollback mechanisms.

Navigate Governance: Coordinate change management through proper governance channels for integrations involving PARIS (the in-house ERP), transitioning tools to operational ownership while retaining management over specific applications.

4. Security, Reliability & Scale

Secure by Design: Safeguard sensitive commercial and operational data by enforcing strict access control, data protection protocols, and environment segregation.

Operational Resilience: Collaborate with the central Technology, Cybersecurity, and Operations teams to define runbooks, support models, and incident response workflows.

Optimize Performance: Continuously enhance platform robustness, processing speed, cloud architecture, and cost efficiency.

Stakeholder Relations

Internal:

Office of the CEO : Align directly on strategic priorities, prototyping needs, and rapid product delivery.

Partner on corporate tech standards, security, architecture, and transitioning

Cross-Functional Stakeholders: Collaborate with business, finance, research, and operational teams to define problems, validate data, and drive tool adoption.

External:

Cloud & AI Vendors: Navigate platforms across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

Specialist Data Providers: Integrate high-consequence external data feeds from Bloomberg, Clarksons, S&P Global, and other maritime or financial networks.

Job Experience & Qualifications

Essential Requirements

Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience as a software, platform, AI, or data engineer, with a proven track record of shipping production-grade systems.

AI & LLM Expertise: Practical experience deploying LLMs in real-world systems, with deep familiarity in agent frameworks, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector stores, and tool orchestration.

Backend Mastery: Strong Python programming skills for backend services, automated workflows, and data handling. Proven experience building robust APIs and multi-source data pipelines.

Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on cloud engineering experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) deploying live services. Solid grounding in modern CI/CD, testing, version control, and core MLOps/LLMOps disciplines.

C-Suite Visualization: Ability to design clear, intuitive web interfaces and data visualizations that translate complex metrics for senior executives.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Mathematics, or a highly technical STEM discipline.

Desirable Assets

Proficiency with dedicated MLOps/LLMOps tooling (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, model registries, evaluation pipelines).

Experience with containerization and orchestration workflows (Docker, Kubernetes).

Prior experience building tools tailored for executive leadership, trading desks, research analysts, or high-consequence decision environments.

Exposure to highly regulated, operationally critical environments or specialized maritime, logistics, and commodities market data.

EYT3 Limited (“EYT3”) is a Pure-Play Cybersecurity and FinTech / Regulatory Technology (RegTech) company based in Hong Kong. The group established in 2016. We specialize in helping organizations to transform to the new digital era through client centric approach and long-term trusted advisor. We are experts in niche areas such as Security Detection and Response, Cyber Threat Protection for Industrial Automation and IoT and Data Analytics for Financial Crime and Fraud Investigation.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a forward-thinking ML / AI Engineer to join our team and contribute to a confidential large language model (LLM) project in the financial services domain. You will work on advanced AI implementation, covering the full model development lifecycle from data preparation and fine-tuning through to production deployment. This role is hands-on and delivery-focused. You will collaborate closely with the cross-functional development team and directly shape the AI capabilities of a live, mission-critical system.

Responsibilities:

Fine-tune open-weight language models on domain-specific data using techniques such as SFT, Quantization, LoRA/QLoRA.

Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including policy document ingestion and vector database integration.

Serve and optimize model inference using production engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang) to meet strict latency and throughput SLAs.

Manage MLOps and deployment pipelines across DEV, UAT, PRE-PRD, and PRD environments on enterprise cloud infrastructure (IBM watsonx.ai / OpenShift).

Utilize modern LLMs and agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GPT-based tools) to accelerate development, code generation, and prompt engineering.

Evaluate emerging open-source models, inference frameworks, and AI libraries for production feasibility.

Produce technical validation reports and contribute to system design and test documentation.

Collaborate with backend and frontend engineers to integrate AI capabilities into the core platform.

Requirements:

Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.

Hands-on experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or model serving in production environments.

Strong proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow).

Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals.

Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers (e.g. Qwen, Deepseek), LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, or similar tools.

Experience with prompt engineering and utilizing cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate development cycles.

Ability to read and write technical documentation in English.

Nice-to-Haves:

Experience with advanced fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, Unsloth, DPO, or RLHF.

Familiarity with quantization (INT4, INT8) and production inference optimization.

Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, pgvector).

Exposure to IBM watsonx.ai, OpenShift, or Kubernetes.

Experience with multilingual NLP, particularly CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) datasets.

Prior hands-on experience with AI projects in financial services or regulated industry.

What We Offer:

Flexible working hours and work-from-home policy.

Subsidized access to premium AI development tools to empower your workflow.

On-job training and technical guidance from senior engineers.

Opportunity to work on a high-impact, production LLM system in the financial services sector.

Exposure to cutting-edge open-weight model stack and enterprise-grade deployment practices.

Job Highlights:

Flexible working hours and work-from-home policy

Hands-on work on confidential LLM projects in Fintech

Great opportunity to deepen expertise in LLM fine-tuning, RAG, and MLOps

jd_raw:
About Langham Hospitality Group   

A wholly-owned subsidiary of Great Eagle Holdings, Langham Hospitality Group (LHG) comprises a family of distinctive brands, including The Langham Hotels and Resorts, Cordis Hotels and Resorts, Eaton Workshop and Ying’nFlo. With over 40 hotels and residences in operation or development, LHG has a global footprint that extends across Asia, Europe, North America, Australasia and the Middle East.   

As Langham Hospitality Group expands its AI capabilities in the 2026 technology roadmap, we are looking for a hands-on Senior AI Engineer to partner closely with the Lead AI Solution Architect to build our next-generation AI platform. 

This role focuses on designing and implementing the technical backbone that connects external AI vendors with Langham’s internal systems, enabling personalized guest experiences, intelligent operations, and data-driven decisioning. You will build proprietary middleware, scalable RAG frameworks, and Agentic orchestration logic that transforms raw off-the-shelf LLMs (from ByteDance, Google, OpenAI, etc.) into hyper-personalized, secure, luxury hospitality engines. 

 
 Key Responsibilities:

          1. AI Platform & Integration 
•    Design and build scalable integrations with external foundational models and AI vendors. 
•    Develop enterprise-grade middleware and API services to connect AI capabilities seamlessly with internal property management systems. 
•    Ensure reliable, secure, and low-latency AI service delivery across global properties. 
•    Implement strict data security measures, LLM guardrails, and PII masking to ensure guest privacy and regulatory compliance. 

         2. Data & Intelligence Layer 
•    Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to unify guest data from multiple sources. 
•    Implement advanced data models for guest profiles, preferences, and behavioral signals. 
•    Enable real-time data streaming and processing to fuel personalization and decision engines. 

         3. AI Orchestration & Agentic Decisioning 
•    Deploy Agentic workflows (via LangGraph or similar) and services that determine the “next best action” for guest interactions. 
•    Implement advanced prompt engineering, dynamic context injection, and response optimization. 
•    Build scalable RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures using vector databases and semantic search. 
•    Create continuous feedback loops (LLMOps) to improve model outputs, reduce hallucinations, and drive business outcomes. 

        4. Experimentation & Optimization 
•    Design A/B testing frameworks for AI-driven features (e.g., tailored offers, conversational messaging, itinerary recommendations). 
•    Monitor performance metrics (latency, accuracy, conversion, revenue uplift, and engagement). 
•    Iterate quickly based on data insights and telemetry. 

Skills & Experience Required:
 
Core Engineering 
•    5+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Python (required). 
•    Extensive experience building APIs, microservices, and high-throughput distributed systems. 
•    Strong background with data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and databases (SQL and NoSQL). 
•    Deep understanding of data modeling for user/customer identities and profiles. 
•    Hands-on familiarity with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
•    Familiarity with data visualization and dashboarding tools (e.g., Power BI or similar) to present telemetry and metrics. 

AI / ML Systems 
•    Proven, hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs into live production systems. 
•    Proficiency with modern orchestration and agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, etc.). 
•    Deep understanding of RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation rubrics. 
•    Hands-on experience with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate), advanced embeddings, and semantic search techniques. 
•    Familiarity with LLMOps tools (e.g., LangSmith, MLflow) to evaluate and monitor agent performance. 

Integration & Architecture 
•    Track record of successfully integrating complex third-party SaaS platforms and APIs. 
•    Strong understanding of event-driven architecture and asynchronous system orchestration. 
•    Ability to design scalable, modular, and loosely coupled systems. 

Soft Skills 
•    Strong problem-solving abilities and an "owner's" mindset. 
•    Comfort operating in a fast-moving, innovative, and sometimes ambiguous environment. 
•    Excellent communication skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation and non-technical business stakeholders. 
 

For more information about Langham Hospitality Group, please visit: http://www.langhamhospitalitygroup.com/

title: Technical Product Manager (AI Infrastructure & Agents)
jd_raw:
Company introduction:

Appcara specializes in providing cloud application management solutions for companies of all sizes around the world. Appcara solutions are used by both Service Providers and directly by enterprises to provide simplified application services on top of their cloud computing environments.

The company was created by a group of cloud computing experts in 2010, who previously built industry leading Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) cloud computing technologies and services including the Savvis Symphony Virtual Private Data Center (VPDC) cloud service, the Sun cloud (Qlayer), as well as managed service provider infrastructures for Equinix and cloud storage at Amplidata. Appcara brings together this team with a vision to remove the barriers involved in deploying and managing enterprise applications in the cloud. Appcara is privately held and is based in Silicon Valley with additional development centers in Singapore and Hong Kong.

About the Role

At Appcara, we are pioneering the unified ecosystem for heterogeneous AI computing and secure agentic workflows. As our Technical Product Manager, reporting directly to the Head of R&D, you will serve as the strategic bridge between our deep-tech architecture and market realization.

You will manage a dual-track product portfolio with distinct focuses:

The Compute Layer: Productizing our high-performance orchestration capabilities across heterogeneous silicon (NVIDIA/AMD/Huawei) into a market-ready infrastructure offering.

The Agent Layer: Leading the commercial strategy for a secure, open ecosystem that enables enterprises to adopt AI Agents (e.g., LangGraph, n8n) with zero-trust governance.

Key Responsibilities

Product Roadmap & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end roadmap for the AppCara AI Middleware, ensuring strict alignment with technical architecture while prioritizing features based on both hardware market trends (e.g., availability of H100 vs. 910B) and the emerging Agentic economy (e.g., MCP standards, Enterprise Guardrails).

Agent Ecosystem & Commercialization: Lead the Go-to-Market strategy for our 'Agent Orchestration' platform. Define how we package our Zero Trust architecture and Data Silos (MCP) protection as premium differentiators against generic agent platforms. Bridge the gap between low-code tools (n8n, Dify) and enterprise security requirements.

Cross-Silicon Strategy: Define the commercial requirements for multi-chip support. Work with R&D to prioritize which features must be available on Huawei/AMD vs. NVIDIA to meet client SLAs, focusing on market readiness rather than low-level implementation.

Value Proposition & Use Cases: Translate complex technical capabilities (e.g., RDMA/InfiniBand latency impact) into compelling commercial use cases, explaining to non-technical clients why they need our specific infrastructure for their AI models.

Market Intelligence & Competitor Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analysis on competitors (e.g., pricing models, feature gaps) and produce actionable reports to guide R&D priorities.

Documentation & GTM Assets: Own the creation of high-quality technical whitepapers, "Definition of Done" criteria for UAT, and Support Matrices. Ensure the Client Services team has everything they need to support the product without escalating to R&D.

Stakeholder & Change Management: Act as the primary buffer for the R&D team. Work with Project Managers to translate "Change Orders" and "Architectural Multipliers" into standard product features, ensuring scope discipline.




Requirements (Must-Haves)

Technical Foundation & Aptitude: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. More importantly, you can grasp complex technical concepts (e.g., Abstraction Layers, Inter-node fabrics) and simplify them for non-technical stakeholders. (We value translation skills over coding skills.)

Hardware Literacy (Willingness to Learn): You don't need to be a hardware expert yet, but you must have high technical agility. You are willing to rapidly learn the nuances between NVIDIA and Huawei accelerators from our engineering team to make informed roadmap decisions.

Agent & LLM Stack Fluency: Strong familiarity with the modern AI software stack, including Agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph), No-code platforms (n8n, Dify), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You understand not only the tools but also why enterprises need Guardrails and Governance.

Security & Governance Mindset: Understanding of Zero Trust principles and Access Control (IAM) in the context of AI. You can articulate the business risks of "rogue agents" and "data leakage" to C-level clients, positioning security as a product feature.

Commercial Acumen: Proven experience in structuring deals. You are comfortable writing SOWs, defining SLAs, and managing tiered subscription models. You understand that technology must ultimately generate revenue.

Documentation Mastery: Exceptional skill in creating high-quality Product Requirement Documents (PRD), Whitepapers, and Datasheets. You must enjoy bringing structure to chaos and shielding the R&D team from ambiguity.

Product Experience: 3+ years in Product Management, specifically within Cloud, SaaS, or AI/ML software.

Communication: Fluent in English and Cantonese (Mandarin is a strong plus) to coordinate with regional hardware vendors and local HK enterprises.




Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Infra Knowledge: Deep understanding of AI Hardware (GPU interconnects, NPU architectures) or Networking protocols (RDMA/InfiniBand) is a huge plus, but not required.

Production Experience: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes/Slurm orchestration or deploying AI Agent workflows in a production environment.

Vertical Expertise: Familiarity with LLM inference optimization (e.g., vLLM) or Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation.

Local Insight: Familiarity with the Hong Kong/Greater Bay Area (GBA) AI ecosystem and government-funded tech initiatives (e.g., Cyberport/HKSTP grants).

Startup DNA: Prior experience in a startup or high-growth tech environment where "wearing multiple hats" is the norm.




What We Offer

Strategic Impact: The opportunity to lead the commercial strategy for a "First-of-its-kind" dual-layer AI platform (Compute + Agents), working directly with the Head of R&D.

Rare Domain Expertise: On-the-job exposure to the bleeding edge of AI Infrastructure & Silicon, a highly scarce and lucrative skill set in the product market.

High-Performance Culture: A dynamic work environment at the heart of Hong Kong’s tech scene, with a team that values logic, efficiency, and architectural elegance.

Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary package with performance-based bonuses aligning with product success.




Attractive remuneration package and fringe benefit will be offered to the right candidate. Interested parties please send your resume with cover letter, stating current and expected salary to the Human Resources & Administration Department by clicking Apply Now.




For more information about us, please visit the corporate website at http://www.appcara.com/




Equal employment opportunities apply to all applicants. All applications and data collected will be treated in strict confidence and used exclusively for recruitment purposes. Only short-listed candidates will be invited for interview. The company will retain the applications for a maximum period of 12 months and may refer suitable candidates to other vacancies within the Group.

Technical Foundation & Aptitude: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. More importantly, you can grasp complex technical concepts (e.g., Abstraction Layers, Inter-node fabrics) and simplify them for non-technical stakeholders. (We value translation skills over coding skills.)

Hardware Literacy (Willingness to Learn): You don't need to be a hardware expert yet, but you must have high technical agility. You are willing to rapidly learn the nuances between NVIDIA and Huawei accelerators from our engineering team to make informed roadmap decisions.

Agent & LLM Stack Fluency: Strong familiarity with the modern AI software stack, including Agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph), No-code platforms (n8n, Dify), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You understand not only the tools but also why enterprises need Guardrails and Governance.

Security & Governance Mindset: Understanding of Zero Trust principles and Access Control (IAM) in the context of AI. You can articulate the business risks of "rogue agents" and "data leakage" to C-level clients, positioning security as a product feature.

Commercial Acumen: Proven experience in structuring deals. You are comfortable writing SOWs, defining SLAs, and managing tiered subscription models. You understand that technology must ultimately generate revenue.

Documentation Mastery: Exceptional skill in creating high-quality Product Requirement Documents (PRD), Whitepapers, and Datasheets. You must enjoy bringing structure to chaos and shielding the R&D team from ambiguity.

Product Experience: 3+ years in Product Management, specifically within Cloud, SaaS, or AI/ML software.

Communication: Fluent in English and Cantonese (Mandarin is a strong plus) to coordinate with regional hardware vendors and local HK enterprises.




Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Infra Knowledge: Deep understanding of AI Hardware (GPU interconnects, NPU architectures) or Networking protocols (RDMA/InfiniBand) is a huge plus, but not required.

Production Experience: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes/Slurm orchestration or deploying AI Agent workflows in a production environment.

Vertical Expertise: Familiarity with LLM inference optimization (e.g., vLLM) or Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation.

Local Insight: Familiarity with the Hong Kong/Greater Bay Area (GBA) AI ecosystem and government-funded tech initiatives (e.g., Cyberport/HKSTP grants).

Startup DNA: Prior experience in a startup or high-growth tech environment where "wearing multiple hats" is the norm.




What We Offer

Strategic Impact: The opportunity to lead the commercial strategy for a "First-of-its-kind" dual-layer AI platform (Compute + Agents), working directly with the Head of R&D.

Rare Domain Expertise: On-the-job exposure to the bleeding edge of AI Infrastructure & Silicon, a highly scarce and lucrative skill set in the product market.

High-Performance Culture: A dynamic work environment at the heart of Hong Kong’s tech scene, with a team that values logic, efficiency, and architectural elegance.

Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary package with performance-based bonuses aligning with product success.

company: Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute Company Limited
jd_raw:
The Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute (ASTRI) was founded by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in 2000 with the mission of enhancing Hong Kong’s competitiveness through applied research. ASTRI’s core R&D competence in various areas is grouped under five Technology Divisions: Communications Technologies, Artificial Intelligence and Trust Technologies, Advanced Electronic Components and Systems, IoT Sensing and AI Technologies, and Intelligent Perception and Control Technologies.

It is applied across six core areas which are Smart City, Financial Technologies, New Industrialisation and Intelligent Manufacturing, Digital Health, Application Specific Integrated Circuits, and Metaverse.

Over the years, ASTRI has nurtured a pool of research, I&T talents and received numerous international awards for its pioneering innovations as well as outstanding business and community contributions. ASTRI has transferred about 1,600 technologies to the industries and has been granted close to 1,200 patents in the Mainland, the United States, and other countries.

To support our constant endeavour to position Hong Kong as a world-class smart city and an international hub of innovation and technology, we are seeking qualified professionals to fill the following position(s):

The Opportunity

We are looking for a seasoned technology leader to define and execute the strategic vision for this TD. In this role, you will lead a sizable, high-caliber research team in building foundational technologies—specifically a base Agentic AI platform—and leveraging that platform to create differentiated, domain-specific solutions. While the AI platform will support other TDs, you will also lead the Digital Health and Intelligent Manufacturing solution domains as well as Trusted Technologies (e.g., cybersecurity and privacy) and FinTech.

This is not just a research management role. It is a strategic leadership position where you will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of innovation, from roadmap planning and project execution to stakeholder management and the critical "1-to-10" journey that amplifies the impact of our technologies.

Reports To: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Location: Hong Kong

Job Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Vision & Technology Roadmap

Develop and maintain a forward-looking research strategy and technology roadmap for the sector, with a core focus on LLM/LVLM, Agentic AI, and Generative AI technologies, as well as their application within Digital Health, Intelligent Manufacturing, Trusted Tech and FinTech.

Identify emerging trends and translate them into actionable research programs that ensure the institute remains at the cutting edge of trusted and responsible AI.

Champion the adoption of AI advancements across the entire institute, enabling other TDs to enhance their research productivity and solution capabilities.

2. Research and Solution Leadership & Team Management

Lead, mentor, and grow a large, multidisciplinary team of top-tier AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration.

Oversee the design and development of a core base Agentic AI platform. This platform will serve as the foundational layer for all solution teams, ensuring reusability, scalability, and robustness.

Guide solution teams in building vertically integrated AI applications for Trusted Technologies and FinTech, ensuring technical alignment with the core platform.

Possess a working knowledge of system deployment architectures and methodologies to guide the team in building solutions that are not only innovative but also feasible for real-world piloting and integration.

3. Commercialization & Impact Acceleration (0→1→10)

Help guide the technology commercialization, ensuring that research outputs are not only innovative but are developed with a clear path to market.

Possess a deep understanding of the "1-to-10" phase. While not responsible for full-scale productization, you will ensure that the "0-to-1" research planning explicitly incorporates the requirements, constraints, and feedback from early-stage validation, pilot projects, and customer engagements.

Work closely with the business development and partnerships teams to identify and secure opportunities for pilot deployments and market validation.

4. Stakeholder & Ecosystem Management

Serve as the primary technical ambassador for the sector to a diverse range of stakeholders, including:

Government Funding Agencies: Articulate the technical merit, strategic alignment, and potential economic impact of research programs to secure funding.

Strategic Clients: Understand their operational challenges and translate them into technological requirements, building trust in the ASTRI’s ability to deliver secure and trusted solutions.

Commercial Customers & Solution Integrators: Effectively communicate the value proposition of our technologies, build strong relationships, and secure their interest and trust as partners in the "1-to-10" journey.

Navigate complex multi-party collaborations, ensuring alignment of interests and smooth project execution.

Job Requirements:

Required Experience:

Proven Leadership: A minimum of 15+ years of experience in technology research and solution development, with at least 8+ years in a senior leadership role managing large, high-performing, and multidisciplinary teams in an applied research, corporate R&D, or advanced solution development environment.

Technical Depth: A strong technical background in AI/ML with a demonstrated ability to keep pace with the latest advancements in LLMs, LVLMs, Agentic AI, and GenAI. Experience architecting and building scalable AI platforms and solutions is essential.

Domain Application: Proven experience applying AI to Trusted Technology domains (e.g., cybersecurity, privacy-preserving tech) and/or FinTech. Experience in other verticals like Digital Health and Intelligent Manufacturing is a plus.

Deployment Acumen: A solid working knowledge of modern software/system deployment practices (e.g., cloud architecture, containerization, CI/CT pipelines for ML). Hands-on experience with solution development and system deployment is strongly preferred.

Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success in taking technologies from the lab to the market. You must have a track record of navigating the "0-to-1" to "1-to-10" transition, working with commercial partners, and understanding product requirements.

Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including government officials, funding bodies, and C-level executives. Experience in a publicly funded or highly regulated environment is a strong plus.

Required Competencies & Attributes:

Strategic Visionary: Ability to think 3-5 years ahead and build a roadmap that aligns technological possibility with market and societal needs.

Operational Excellence: Strong project management skills with experience in overseeing a portfolio of complex research projects.

Influencer & Communicator: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; adept at ensuring high-quality proposals, white papers, and presenting to large audiences.

Collaborative Leader: A natural networker who can build bridges internally (across TDs) and externally (with partners).

Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot strategies based on rapid technological advancements and market feedback.

Why Join Us?

Mission-Driven Impact: Play a pivotal role in shaping the applied AI landscape and solving problems that matter.

Cutting-Edge Environment: Work with state-of-the-art technology and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the ecosystem.

Strategic Aspiration: The mandate to build a leading AI research TD from a position of strength.

Public Service with Entrepreneurial Spirit: The stability of a public institution with the drive and agility of a tech startup focused on impact.

The appointment will be on renewable contract terms with a competitive salary and performance-linked gratuity. Fringe benefits include paid leave, medical and dental benefits, insurance coverage and contribution to MPF. The incumbent will normally work a five-day week.

For interested parties, please submit your application with detailed CV within two weeks of the post date. Applicants are encouraged to submit their applications as soon as possible. The review of applications will continue until post is filled.

Position offer is subject to the applicant’s experience and academic qualification. The application will be open until the position is filled. Only short-listed candidates will be notified. ASTRI reserves the right not to fill the position.

ASTRI is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used exclusively for recruitment only. For details, please refer to Privacy - ASTRI - Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute Company Limited.

title: AI Algorithm Engineer
jd_raw:
AI 算法工程师

- 业务场景：面向连锁门店厨房设备智能运维（KitchenHub AI 系统）。

- 技术方向：AIoT 物联网、云端微服务、边缘计算、AI 智能运维。




岗位概述：基于不同业务场景下的设备运维数据进行模型 Fine-tune，并深入研究利用大模型（LLM）进行数据标注与知识蒸馏，产出可在嵌入式系统上长期持续运行的小模型，支撑边缘计算端的智能运维与状态评估。

 

核心职责

1. 基于门店环境、设备运行等不同业务场景的数据，使用成熟框架进行各类模型的 Fine-tune、验证与效果评估。

2. 研究并应用大模型（LLM）对海量复杂数据进行自动化标注与清洗提炼。

3. 实施大模型到小模型的知识蒸馏，打磨出占用资源小、运行效率高，可在嵌入式系统上长期稳定运行的轻量级模型。

4. 完成模型打包，配合软硬件团队落地云端/边缘端推理部署。

5. 参与数据预处理、特征工程与标注规则制定。

6. 监控线上端侧推理与模型效果，定期进行迭代优化。

任职要求

必备能力

1. 熟练使用 Python，掌握数据预处理与特征工程。

2. 熟悉 Scikit-learn/TensorFlow/PyTorch 任一主流机器学习框架，有基础模型 Fine-tune、验证与评估实战经验。

3. 深入理解大模型（LLM）原理，具备运用大模型进行数据标注、Prompt 优化及知识蒸馏的实操经验。

4. 能处理时序数据、传感器数据，理解设备运维数据特征，并掌握模型压缩与量化技术。

5. 能使用 AI 辅助工具提升模型开发与迭代效率。

优先能力

1. 有时序预测、设备故障诊断相关项目经验。

2. 了解边缘模型轻量化（TensorRT/ONNX等）实际部署。

3. 有餐饮/工业设备运维算法经验。

title: Associate Product Manager (FormX.ai)
jd_raw:
FormX.ai is an AI-powered document automation platform used by enterprises across Asia. We process over 12 million documents a year for clients across industries. We're a small, technical team that ships fast.

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager to work directly with our founder — you'll learn what product management looks like in an AI-native B2B company, from the ground up.

What we're building in 2026

Document Extraction APIs - deeper accuracy, better developer experience across the 12M+ documents we process annually

AI Agent Workspace - a new platform to reimagine how AI agents reshape document workflows for enterprises

What you'll do

You'll be working closely with our founder/CEO, who leads product. Your job is to be his eyes, ears, and hands in the field.

Talk to clients — join enterprise meetings, listen hard, ask good questions, and bring back what you learn

Prototype fast - vibe code in Cursor or Claude Code to validate ideas before they touch engineering time

Support sales and marketing — help prepare pitch decks, battlecards, and competitive comparisons

Follow up relentlessly — make sure nothing falls through the cracks between clients, engineering, and sales

You're a fit if:

Vibe coding is already part of how you work - it's not optional here

You'd rather be in a room with people than behind a screen all day — but you also love thinking quietly on your own

You're genuinely curious about technology, even if you're not a developer yet — you've opened a terminal before, or you're the type who would just to figure something out

You understand AI at a product level: embeddings, prompt tuning, agents, tool calling, MCP

You present well and can explain things simply to people who aren't technical

You reason logically and don't jump to conclusions — you'd rather ask one more question than guess

You're organized enough to keep everyone aligned without being asked twice

Who this might be for

Junior Developer — you get how things are built, but you'd rather be talking to customers than writing code all day

UI/UX Designer — you're already shipping with AI, but you want to be the one presenting the feature to the client, not handing it off

Sales / Biz Dev — you've gone down the rabbit hole (embeddings, vibe coding, running models locally) and want to be in the driving seat of what you're selling, not just selling it

Analyst / Consultant / Customer Success — you're tired of handing work off and watching others decide. One catch: this role requires getting your hands dirty — you'll need to use AI tools, poke around in terminals, and figure things out yourself, not just document them

title: Data Architect (AVP) – Chief Data Office - IT
jd_raw:
Company Introduction:

We’re home to Asia's most dynamic and vibrant capital markets.
Connecting capital, ideas, inspiration and innovation for deeper, more diverse and liquid global capital markets; providing greater choice and opportunity for our customers, each and every day.

HKEX is a purpose-driven company. Our commitment to the long-term development of our business and our markets is articulated in our purpose: "To Connect, Promote and Progress our Markets and the Communities they support for the prosperity of all."

Job Summary:

Data Architect supports Chief Data Office by building a scalable, well structured, and AI ready data foundation. As HKEX expands its data warehouse, modernizes platforms, and increases the use of analytics and AI, this role ensures that data is organized, governed, and modeled effectively.

The incumbent will work closely with senior architect and data engineers to improves data quality, accessibility, and efficiency across systems, enabling better decision making and smoother adoption of emerging technologies.

Job Duties:

Data Architecture & Modeling

Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models for the enterprise data warehouse and data marts.

Participate in defining data standards, modeling conventions, and reusable data patterns.

Support dataset design for analytics, BI, and machine‑learning workloads.

Data Platform & Ecosystem

Design frameworks for metadata management, data governance, lineage tracking, and asset cataloging.

Support configuration of data quality rules and workflows.

Managing modeling and documentation activities within the Data Platform environment.

Data Mining, Machine Learning & AI for Data Warehouse

Apply basic data mining techniques (profiling, clustering, outlier detection) to better understand source data and inform data model design.

Use machine learning fundamentals to identify opportunities for optimization (e.g., workload prediction, query pattern analysis, intelligent partitioning).

Support the application of AI in the data warehouse, such as:

Automated metadata classification

AI‑driven data quality rule recommendations

Pattern detection for schema improvements

Automating ETL logic generation

Collaborate with data analysts to ensure warehouse structures support ML pipelines and feature stores.

ETL / Data Pipeline Development

Provide architecture consultancy on improving ETL/ELT pipelines developments quality and efficiency.

Design data flows between on‑premises systems, cloud storage, and the data warehouse.

Contribute idea to improving pipeline reliability and monitoring.

Cloud Data Warehouse Support

Manage data warehouse cloud migration tasks such as mapping, validation, and reconciliation.

Support POCs for cloud-based architectures, storage layers, and compute services.

Develop and apply best practices for scalable, secure cloud DW architecture.

Cross‑Team Collaboration & Governance

Work with data engineers, analysts, and business teams to deliver data requirements.

Support governance processes such as data lineage, catalog updates, and access reviews.

Document technical designs, data dictionaries, and operational procedures.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related field.

5+ years of experience in data engineering and architecture, particularly within the FSI sector.

Understanding of data architecture principles (data layers, integration patterns, schema design).

Hands‑on experience with data modeling tools.

A fast learner with understanding of data technology a preference.

Experience with ETL/ELT development and SQL transformation logic.

Foundational exposure to cloud data warehouses

Basic understanding of Visualization tools, Data mining methods (profiling, segmentation, correlation analysis), Machine learning concepts (supervised vs. unsupervised learning, model lifecycle), AI applications in data management (metadata extraction, classification, automation)

HKEX is committed as an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values and we look to support, respect diverse perspectives, abilities, culture and experiences within our workplace.

Position Summary:

The Lead Solution Architect is responsible for end to end application and system architecture for government and public sector clients, with a strong focus on XC 信创（信息技术应用创新）as well as the migration and transformation from traditional databases to XC databases。 The role leads a team of solution architects to understand complex business requirements and produce cost effective, compliant, and innovative solutions for large scale digital transformation projects.

Key Responsibilities:

·       Lead solution architecture for government tenders, owning overall technical strategy, target architecture, and solution integrity from pre‑sales through delivery.

·       Analyse RFI/RFQ/RFP documents and government technical standards, map requirements to feasible solutions, and drive the creation of winning technical tender proposals.

·       Design secure, scalable microservices architectures (API‑enabled, containerized, DevOps‑enabled) covering applications, integration, data, security, and infrastructure layers.

·       Define and maintain reference architectures, reusable patterns and templates for microservices, API gateways and messaging services.

·       Provide governance and technical leadership to a team of solution architects and technical leads; review and sign‑off solution designs, estimates, and risk registers.

·       Collaborate with project managers, account managers, business analysts, security, operations and vendor partners to ensure solutions are deliverable within cost, schedule, risk and compliance constraints.

·       Ensure architectures comply with government IT,  Information security, data security, standards, industry regulatory requirements, as well as the implementation of security controls such as identity authentication, access control, encryption, and log auditing.

·       Participate in customer workshops, steering committees and architecture review boards; Articulate the value, risks, and roadmap of the solution to senior business and technical leaders.

·       Lead assessment and migration from traditional databases (e.g. Oracle/MySQL/SQL Server) to XC databases (e.g. GaussDB，Kingbase and OceanBase).

·       Define database migration methodologies (assessment, schema & SQL Compatibility analysis), data migration, synchronization, and cutover rehearsals, and guiding the program team to use vendor or third-party migration tools to complete the migration of the XC database.

·       Define and govern XC modernization blueprints, including the selection and integration solutions for XC  middleware, databases, big data, and security products.




Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or related discipline.

15+ years overall IT experience, including at least 8 years as a Solution Architect and 5+ years in a lead/manager role.

Solid experience in government or public‑sector tenders, including leading technical responses, solution costing, and presentations for medium‑to‑large projects.

Hands‑on architecture and implementation experience with microservices (e.g. Spring Cloud, .NET microservices, service mesh, API gateway, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD).​

Proven experience delivering projects on XC middleware, databases, and related ecosystems.

Practical experience migrating at least one sizeable system from traditional databases to XC databases (e.g. Kingbase, OceanBase, DM, etc.), including evaluation, modification, data migration, and production cutover.

Strong background in enterprise integration patterns, REST/gRPC APIs, messaging, and data streaming, ideally on both traditional and XC ecosystem

 

Key Skills and Competencies:

Architecture leadership: Ability to define target state architectures and roadmaps across applications, data, integration and infrastructure.

Government tender expertise: Skilled in interpreting tender specifications, marking scores criteria, building a technical compliance matrix, optimizing architectural costs, and endorsing the solution during clarification meetings/demonstrations.

Traditional and XC Database Capabilities: Deep understanding of the positioning and technology ecosystem of the XC industry, with extensive experience in the characteristics of traditional databases, compatibility differences, SQL dialect conversion, migration tools, and common issues.

Analytical & problem‑solving: Able to assess the difficulty of legacy system transformation, performance and capacity requirements, and migration risks, and propose a phased, reversible migration and evolution plan.

Stakeholder communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in Chinese and English

Team management: Experience leading and mentoring multi‑disciplinary teams of architects

jd_raw:
A major financial organisation in Hong Kong is investing heavily in AI and expanding its AI & Innovation team. They’re looking for an AI Platform Lead who can build and run the infrastructure that helps AI teams deliver real solutions—fast, safely, and at scale.

What you’ll do

Lead a small engineering group to build scalable AI platforms (on-prem or cloud-native)

Set up and improve MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps so AI projects move smoothly from dev to deployment

Work closely with data scientists and AI engineers to improve model performance and resource use (especially compute/GPU)

Maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for consistent deployments

Run proof-of-concept work to test new AI tools and platform approaches

Collaborate with stakeholders to align platform capabilities with business needs




What we’re looking for

3+ years building AI/ML platforms, with strong software engineering skills

Experience with GPU-based AI infrastructure

Strong knowledge of AI platform concepts (e.g., RAG and fine-tuning approaches like LoRA)

Hands-on experience with MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps

Familiarity with data privacy/security expectations for AI systems

Chinese speaker with good command in English is required

Comfortable with the typical stack, including:

Python / SQL / Bash (PowerShell a plus)

Docker, Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes

Jenkins, Git, Ansible (plus related DevSecOps tools)

MLflow, Ray, vLLM, Weaviate, Dify

Grafana/Prometheus/Loki-style monitoring/observability
